events.asset: Accelerated TMS (multiple sessions per day, such as SAINT/SNT or SWIFT) for PTSD, bipolar disorder, OCD or ADHD
events.entity: US health plans (Blue Cross Blue Shield plans and other commercial or public payers)
events.title: A US health plan covers accelerated TMS for PTSD, bipolar disorder, OCD or ADHD
events.proposition: A US health plan publishes a medical policy that covers accelerated TMS as medically necessary for at least one of PTSD, bipolar disorder, OCD or ADHD.
events.criterion: TRUE on the effective date of a published medical policy, coverage bulletin or fee schedule from a US health plan (a Blue Cross Blue Shield plan or another commercial or public payer) that lists an accelerated TMS protocol (multiple sessions per day, such as SAINT/SNT or SWIFT) as medically necessary for at least one of post-traumatic stress disorder, bipolar disorder, obsessive-compulsive disorder or attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder. FALSE at the deadline when no such policy has taken effect by then. Resolved on the payer's published policy bulletin.

resolution_source.name: US health plan medical policy bulletins (Blue Cross Blue Shield plan policy libraries and other payer policy sites)

readings: 'PTSD, bipolar, depression, OCD, and even ADHD might be next' is read as one event satisfied by a policy on any one of the listed indications ('A or B' is one event).

'depression' in the list is read as already covered by the first clause ('a nationwide standard of medical necessity is being set in the treatment of depression') and is excluded; the new indications are PTSD, bipolar disorder, OCD and ADHD.
'next' = a coverage policy published after the depression policies the forecaster describes; the payer set is US health plans, as in the forecaster's BCBS examples.
The list is read as 'at least one of' PTSD, bipolar disorder, OCD or ADHD; depression is excluded as already covered per the author.
The first clause, on a depression standard being set, is description, not a coded forecast.
